review.posthog_relevance: Calendly warehouse source connector credential validation and error differentiation
review.reason: The observed changes demonstrate a refactoring of the credential validation API for the Calendly warehouse connector. P1.F1.H1 shows the return type change from boolean to a tuple, P1.F2.H1 shows the unpacking of this tuple in the connector implementation, and P1.F3.H1 shows the corresponding test assertion updates. This indicates a substantive, bounded improvement in the connector
